C1565.title: Axios Supply Chain Poisoning: Compromised Front-End HTTP Library Propagates Malicious Code via Dependency Chain
C1565.summary: In April 2026, the National Cybersecurity Notification Center issued an alert regarding a supply chain poisoning attack targeting the JavaScript HTTP library Axios. Malicious code was concealed using obfuscation, self-deletion, and anti-debugging techniques, executing upon developer installation or update to steal credentials and achieve remote code execution.
